title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 446B (Lesser penalties for One Person Companies or small companies)

content.overview: Where a penalty is payable by a One Person Company, small company, start-up company or Producer Company, or by its officer in default, the penalty shall not be more than one-half of the specified penalty, subject to a maximum of two lakh rupees for the company and one lakh rupees for the officer.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: The reduction is statutory. A start-up is one recognised under the DPIIT notification. The section applies to penalties, not to offences punishable with imprisonment.
